original_observation.stderr_excerpt_exact: RuntimeError: Tokenizer Git blob identity mismatch
original_observation.scope: Qwen small-file collector only; no model loading, GPU operation, or weight download
original_observation.root_cause: Qwen3-8B/tokenizer.json is LFS-managed. Its blobId names the Git LFS pointer, not the 11,422,654-byte payload. The collector incorrectly applied the ordinary Git-blob SHA1 rule to this payload.

minimal_fix: If the official API entry contains lfs, verify payload SHA-256 against lfs.sha256; otherwise verify ordinary Git blob SHA1 against blobId. Persist fetch events immediately and retain prior events between calls.
task_round_accounting: Reported to the main controller for inclusion in the task-wide correction record; this subtask does not allocate an independent repair budget.
other_observations: An initial read-only shell probe used python, which is absent locally; reran with existing python3, without installation.

web.open could read the official model cards but returned Internal Error for both API URLs; the ordinary HTTPS metadata collector successfully retrieved the official API responses. No proxy/network settings were changed.
